title: T2DKP User Survey
summary: Help shape the future of the T2D Knowledge Portal!
bodyHtml: As we plan for the future of the AMP T2D Knowledge Portal, it would be extremely helpful to us to hear from all T2DKP users. Your input and scientific needs will help determine new directions for the T2DKP! We would appreciate your taking a few minutes to fill out this survey by Friday November 8.
